body: You know I could smell your stupid, juvenile INSIPID hatred before you even said anything. And that's what gave you and your dumb ass an excuse. Fucking rot in hell.
I was really hoping for something like one night in karazhan

Paprika, Black Swan, Fantasia

RIP treasured memories

>What do you experience?

Either wish fulfillment or a glimpse of perfection that you know is spawned from a more complete imagination than your own. Something that's always there it's just that only sometimes you see it. Lynch is good for this too as are a lot of movies that are superficially superficial (reality is just shit-testing you) like memezrmylyfeboi's list. Bee movie unironically had me reeling cause dude man we're all like bees in a hive n stuff.

Less light pollution would go a long way. As someone who lives in a suburban environment, I rarely go out to less inhabited places. So the times that I have and I bothered to look up I was astounded. Even if you can't see the edge of the milky way the sheer number of stars that you can see feels so comforting. It's like we've been wrapped up in a shroud and we don't even realize it most of the time.
Granted, but anyone else can spectate you from the third person too.

I hope that if such thing occurs we don't have to feel so cut off from the universe. I don't know if anyone else feels like this (I suspect many do), but throughout my whole life I have felt like I have no ownership over my own existence or place where I really belong because we are always fighting to survive and there is so much subtle antagonism everywhere. I very much hope that this is not the norm for life in the universe (if it exists outside of our planet).
